title: Cosmic Mind Oracle
description: A large glowing plasma globe sits atop a vintage black metallic base, its central pink sphere emitting bright blue and purple electrical arcs. Inside the transparent sphere, a surreal female face with glowing yellow eyes is visible, merging with mechanical and cosmic elements against a dark background filled with floating planets and swirling magenta energy lines.
prompt: Surreal cosmic artwork featuring a large plasma globe on an ornate vintage base. Inside the glowing glass sphere, a mysterious female face with luminous golden eyes merges with mechanical details. Bright blue and magenta electrical arcs radiate from a central pink orb. Dark background filled with floating colorful planets and swirling energy ribbons in magenta and purple, mystical and ethereal atmosphere, highly detailed digital painting.
